description: One contract's destinations over time, the contracts or endpoints it names next, and when Ohey first and last read it. Returns contracts as an array, one entry per chain the address is tracked on (usually one), each with history: its 20 most recent changes, and historyCapped is true only when older changes exist beyond them. A destination no longer in destinations has lastSeen set to the day its replacement was first read. Empty, with a coverage note, when Ohey does not track it.
name: get_etherhiding_contract
title: Get an EtherHiding contract
